༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa byed lugs kyi lag len dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa byed lugs kyi lag len dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen pa la/ rwa skyo sogs kyi yig cha dngos bstan phal cher la/ las tshogs kho na don du gnyer ba'i bsnyen pa'i dbang du mdzad gda' na'ang*/ las tshogs don gnyer gyi gang zag nye tshe ba la dgongs pa yin/ spyir bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir mchog sgrub pa kho na gtso che la/ sgrub pa'am bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma yin na/ las tshogs gtso mi che/ dbang po rab kyi mchog gi dngos grub kyi brgyud pa'i rgyu'am/ phal che ba la dgongs nas thun mong gi dngos grub kyi rgyu yin pa dang*/ dbang po shin tu tha mas kyang las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub ces/ spyir gyi las tshogs 'grub pa zhar byung dang*/ las tshogs kyang drag las kho na ma yin gyi/ las bzhi cha mnyam yin no/ /de ltar yin pa rtog pa dang po kho na la brtags pas shes/ 'dir rgyud las dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub chen po'i ming yin pas/ dngos grub dang las sbyor tsam gyi phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mi 'grub kyi/ de 'grub pa la rdzogs rim dgos par dgongs so/ /las sbyor zhes pa ni/ dngos grub la dngos su mtshams sbyor ba la yang las sbyor zer la/ 'on kyang de las bzhi sogs phra mo'i sgrub thabs ni ma yin no/ /des na rgyud 'dir las dang po pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams kyi/ las bzhi sgrub tshul rnam pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las sbyor du shes par bya'o/ / de ltar spyir nges par byas nas/ las dang po pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/ dang por sgrib sbyong dang tshogs bsags ci rigs par byas la/ legs par tshags su tshud pa'i gnas khang dang*/ phyir yo byad gsar du blang du mi btub pas/ yo byad kyang tshags su tshud par byas/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma rgya cher btang*/ bar chad mi 'jug par gsol ba btab pa lan mang du bya/ de rjes bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/

khrus gsol dri ma sbyang ba rnams gal che/ tho brtsegs te khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ gu gul gyis bdug /de dag gi bar bar du 'byung po spyi dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma yang mang du btang*/ bar chad bsrung ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub par gsol ba btab/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor gzhan gang yang rung ba la bsnyen pa grangs bsnyen tsam song na/ bdag nyid kho nas byas kyang rung la/ ma song na sbyang ba gsum po de bsnyen song dam tshig dang ldan pa gzhan gyis byed dgos so/ /zhag shas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang yig brgya mang du bzla/ a mo gha badzra kyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun mas sgrub thabs dang*/ la li ti'i gzhung chung du grags pa'i ro langs brgyad bskor gyi rgya gzhung de'i lugs ltar na/ khro bo bcu'i bsrung 'khor yang zhag shas sgom pa yang dgos pas bsnyen pa gzhan rnams dang mthun pas legs kyang*/ deng sang lags len la mi mdzad cing mi dgos so/ /bsnyen pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos de rnams dkyil 'khor 'di'i bsnyen pa thog ma'ang nges par gal che/ bsnyen pa skyar ma la mtha' dag la dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ rig pas ji ltar 'os pa dag bya'o/ /'di mchog sgrub yin pas kha blta phyogs gtso mi che yang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun la/ rang gi gdong lho phyogs su lta ba kho na mdzad cing*/ bris sku dang mchod bshams phyogs su gang bde ba la bltas pas chog kyang*/ sgrub pa po rang nyid la phyogs pa gtso che/ bsnyen pa'i gtor ma ni gsum ste/ yi dam gyi gtor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po rnams so/ / gsum gar yang zlum po dmar gtor du bya ste/ mchod pa bshams tshul sogs spyi dang mthun/ de rjes bsnyen mtshams dam por sdoms/ thun du bcad nas bsgom dgos pa la/ thun dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs re bya ste/

thun phyi ma rnams la sngar yod gsal 'debs pa'i tshul ma gtogs/ gsar du bskyed chog mi dgos pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ gsal snang la brtan pa ma thob pa dang*/ thun mtshams su ngag smra ba sogs la de mi legs pas/ mngon rtogs thun re bzhin bskyed/ thun re bzhin bsdu ba yin pa las/ skyabs sems dang yig brgya dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams bzhag kyang chog ste/ de dag gcig tu gsal bar ma gsungs pa dang*/ de rnams bdun rnam dag dang tshad med bzhir 'dus pa'i phyir zhes bla mas gsungs/ so so'i ngag 'don dang dmigs pa rnams ma chad par shar gyis btang la/ bzlas pa'i sngon du lha'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor brtan pa gcig bskyed/ dmigs pa rgyas pa ni rgya ston gyi yi ge dang*/ shog khra dpe'u ris byas pa de ka rwa ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin par snang ste/ rwa los mdzad par grags pa'i 'grel pa gsum gyi dgongs pa yang de kar gda'/ kho bo'i bla ma bla chen rnams kyang de ltar bzhed/ pha mes bla ma rnams ni rwa nub pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ sngags 'khor bsdus pa 'di ga kho na mdzad/ rwa shes rgyal gyis bsgrigs pa'i rwa pod du grags pa yang gser pod kyi dpe rnams nyams pas gser 'dra'i po ti brtsams so zhes lo rgyus cung zad dang bcas pa gsung gin gda'/ 'di pa'i lugs la mngon rtogs rim pa lnga dang*/ dkyil chog yid bzhin gter mdzod dang rtog bdun gyi rkang 'grel dug bcos skor dang bcas pa rnams yi ge snga ma stor ba'i yig tshab tsam yin par bzhed/ 'on kyang man ngag dang gsung sgros skyon med yin du rung gsungs/ bdag de gnyis las gcig kho na'i phyogs mi 'dzin yang*/ 'di ltar nyams len khyer bde ba bsdus pa'i lugs ltar na/ rang gi snying gar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhi ba/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'ang rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa/ de'i lte ba khong stong du gnas pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūṃ nag po me 'bar ba gcig bsgom/ mtha' skor du sngags phreng rnams kha dog nag po me lce dmar po 'bar ba/ de'i phyi rol la 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ so so'i bzlas pa ni ci nus bzlas pa'i skabs/ sa bon ni sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las me lce 'ur gyi 'bar/ rdo rje'i rwa gseb nas thon/ 'jam dpal gyi sku'i cha thams cad nas 'phros/ rtsa zhal nas me lce myug myug byung*/ me gseb nas sngags kyi yi ge me 'bar ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ rtsa zhal gyi me lce'i rtse nas sngags kyi yi ge du ma lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams sngags 'phreng gi rnam par bsdus/ rtsa zhal sogs sngar gyi lam nas zhugs te sngar gyi lam nas thim pas/ me lce 'bar ba dang*/ 'od zer gyi rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par bsam/ de nyid yang yang bsgom/ 'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa bdun pa las/ de ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can de bdag nyid yin par bsgoms nas/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas dpa' bo gnas la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ phy-i nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ bzlas pa'i dus su rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sngags kyi rnam pa bsam te 'bar ba dang phyi nas ma yengs pa'i yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bzla grogs mdzad pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ sngags kyi bzlas tshul ni/ thun re re la rim can du/ bzlas pa'i go rim dang*/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i go rim mo/ / dang po ni/ dang por rtsa sngags/ bar du snying po/ mthar nye snying ngo*/ / gang gtso bor bzla ba'i mang nyung gi khyad par ma gtogs/ thun gcig la go rim 'di kho nar nges so/ /man ngag bsdus pa 'di'i lugs la/

/rtsa sngags bzla ba'i skabs hūṃ la rtsa sngags kho nas bskor/ snying po bzla ba'i skabs de zhu nas snying por gyur pa sogs/ nye snying la yang rigs 'gres/ gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni dang por/ nye snying la bar du snying po la mthar rtsa sngags la byed/ grangs tshad ni/ sngags btus pa'i rtog pa'i skabs su gsungs pa rnams sngon gyi gang zag la dgongs pa yin la/ da ltar ni spyi dang mthun par snying po/ nye snying gnyis la 'bru 'bum dang*/ rtsa sngags labazhi 'bum bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa chung ngu song ste/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa'i las tshogs ci rigs pa sgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ / gsum po gang rung re la bye bsnyen song na/ so so'i bsnyen pa chen po zhes bya ste/ bsnyen pa chung ngus gsum ga dang*/ gang rung gcig gis bsnyen pa chen po song bas/ las mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ gsum ga la bsnyen pa chen po song na ni/ las thogs pa med pa 'grub pa zhes bya'o/ /dngos grub kyi don du ni tshad med do/ /zhes gsungs yang*/ lha'i gsal snang la brtan pa thob na ni bzlas pa nyung yang dngos grub 'grub la/ de ma thob na bzlas pa bye ba phrag brgya'i kyang dngos grub mngon du 'gyur pa ma yin no/ /de bas na dngos grub kyi don du bsam gtan bya/ las tshogs kyi don du sngags bzlas bya ba yang phyogs gcig nas don la gnas so/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa gang yang rung ba sngon du song nas/ kha bskong gi skabs su/ mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ khams gsum sngags kyi sgrar shes pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ / gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thun thams cad kyi tha mar gcig kho na 'bul na/ nam phyed kyi dus sam/ srod kyi mthar 'bul/ lan gnyis 'bul na/ thun thog mtha' gnyis la bya/ thun thams cad la 'grub na shin tu legs/ thun grangs ni ji ltar 'dod pa byas kyang chog pa'i skabs yod de lag len gsum dang bzhi gtso che'o/

kha zas byin rlabs sogs ma chad pa dang/ thun mtshams thams cad du tha mal du ma song bar so so'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa gal che'o/ / 'phreng ba byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ mngon rtogs dkyus ma rnams na'ang gsal mod kyi/ nyin re bzhin dang thun re bzhin du byin rlabs bsdus pa ni/ 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo hrīḥ yig dmar po 'phred du bsgrags pa las byung ba'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal du mos/ hṝḥṣti sogs lan bdun tsam bzlas te/ de tsam gyi chog /rgyas pa ni hrīḥlas byung ba'i 'od dpag med dam/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa gang rung du bskyed/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bkur mchod bstod/ zhu ba las mgo 'phreng du gyur par mos la/ gang gtso bor bzlas pa'i sngags de brgya rtsa bzla/ sen mo lcags kyu lta bu'i lha'i thugs ka nas 'dren par bsam/ 'di ni sngags so so'i bsnyen pa 'phro mtshams sogs la lan re re bya'o/ /'di rnams kyi gnad phran bu than thun da dung zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang ma ṇi pa sogs don du gnyer ba mang pos snga mo nas bskul ba dang*/ khyad par sa skyong chos bzhin pa nam mkha'i tshe dbang phun tshogs kyis bkas bskul nas tā ra nā thas 'phral du smras pa'o// // maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 110 -- PAGE 111 -- PAGE 105 -
